orderComparisons.scope: Exact parsed graph, camera array, point count, and RMS equality. Timing fields, progress-stage callback order, and source/provenance metadata are excluded. Absent geometry fields are explicitly marked absent; equality does not imply successful registration or any acceptance gate.
